## About
Tom's is a locally-owned family business serving Pacifica and the San Mateo County Coastside. Tom Spruitenburg was born and raised in the Vallemar district, and he works out of the same spot where his father Joe ran Joe's Auto Body.
Shari Lancaster runs the office and Allan Berrios runs the shop floor. When your car comes in, our technicians take apart the damaged parts so the estimators can find hidden damage, we get insurance authorization, and glass, mechanical and suspension work is done in house. Before you pick it up, the car gets a final quality check.
We're rated 4.5 from 42 Google reviews, and we'd like to earn yours the same way: by fixing it right and treating you like a neighbor.

## Services
- Collision repair: Our estimators look for both visible and hidden damage, then the team coordinates the repairs to bring your car back to its pre-accident condition.
- Towing and roadside service: Towing and roadside assistance for Coastside car owners, day or night, every day of the week.
- Paint and scratch repair: Everything from small scratch and paint repairs to a full repaint, whether you're fixing a collision or freshening up an older car.
- Glass, mechanical and suspension work: When a repair calls for glass, mechanical or suspension work, it's done here in our own shop.
- Detailing with every collision repair: Every collision repair goes home with a fresh detail, inside and out.

## FAQ
Q: Will you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We're an independently owned shop that works with all insurance companies, and our team can help you with the paperwork.

Q: Can I get a tow outside shop hours?
A: Yes. Towing and roadside assistance are available around the clock, every day of the week, for Coastside drivers.

Q: Does anyone at the shop speak Spanish?
A: Yes. Our shop manager, Allan Berrios, speaks English and Spanish.
